chapter: Pianists, Basie, Lil Armstrong and closing
title: Fats Waller's appetites in Chicago
summary: Fats ate steaks at the DeLisa, lived at the Trenier Hotel and served whisky from a pail, according to Leon Washington.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Who played piano: the pianists musicians remembered

blocks.x: Never affected his playing, never affected it. Another great drinker was Fats Waller.
Fats used to come and-- great eater,
Yeah, right. He would come in the Club DeLisa when we were there, and we had a steam table, and this was when it was on the other side of the street, --

Right, the first one. And he would order a steak with all the trimmings, and then say, while I'm eating this one, cook me another one. And then he had -- he would have Lynn or Healy or whatever company downtown had rented an organ. He lived at the Trenier Hotel. That was at 39th and King Drive -- South Park then.

Yeah. And he had this -- and then it seemed like certain guys -- Art seemed to be like that, they never wanted to be alone, they always wanted somebody around them or with them. And Leon Washington, the saxophone player that used to be with me, he worked in Fats' band one time, one of the big bands. And so when he came to Chicago -- I think he was around here...

But, anyway, whenever he come to Chicago, he'd want Leon to run with him and go with him and then they'd go to the barbershop and Fats would be making the barbers drunk and they got these razors. Leon said, man, he's crazy, he's crazy. And then he would take you down to his house, and he loved to
serve whisky in a -- he had a big pail, great -- like the wash pails?
Buy a brand new pail and fill that up with whisky. And then he would have a dipper.
And then you'd go and you'd dip your whisky out, and this was the thing. This guy -- oh, he was a character. Beautiful man, beautiful.
He worked a lot at the Panther Room at the Sherman Hotel.
And then the Bfields -- they were the owners, Bfield was one of the owners, crazy about Fats.
